definitions.explanation: Hand-held cutting shears used to prune branches, stems, and twigs in gardening. From {剪定|せんてい} (pruning) + はさみ (scissors), with rendaku turning はさみ into ばさみ.

examples.japanese: {剪定|せんてい}ばさみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I cut the branch with pruning shears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}{仕事|しごと}→庭仕事：20710_niwashigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{剪定|せんてい}ばさみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Pruning shears are indispensable for gardening work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{切|き}れ{味|あじ}→切れ味：19110_kireaji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{剪定|せんてい}ばさみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|いた}め→傷める：02098_itameru⟧にくい。
examples.english: Using sharp pruning shears makes it less likely to damage the tree.

notes:
A gardening tool for cutting branches and stems. Compound of ⟦{剪定|せんてい}→剪定：06327_sentei⟧ (pruning) + ⟦はさみ→はさみ：00702_hasami⟧ (scissors); the ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ voices to ば by rendaku.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {剪定|せんてい}ばさみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut with pruning shears
- {剪定|せんてい}ばさみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧: to sharpen the pruning shears

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{植木|うえき}→植木：04001_ueki⟧ばさみ: garden/topiary shears — broader term for shears used on garden plants
- ハサミ: scissors — general-purpose, not for woody branches
